recommended_change: Refactor top-level row-completion handoff so matrix ingress acceptance is not circularly blocked by postproc readiness. Specifically: (1) decouple mat_ready from immediate pp_in_ready on the last chunk by buffering completed row result in a registered pending slot, (2) drive pp_in_valid from that pending slot until accepted (lossless valid/ready behavior), and (3) only advance/clear pending row-result state on actual postproc acceptance while allowing matrix stream progress per FSM phase rules. Ensure no combinational latch behavior in this control block by assigning defaults on all paths.
do_not_change: Do not modify frozen tests or reference model.

Do not alter arithmetic definitions (INT8 multiply, INT32 wrap, optional bias/ReLU behavior).
Do not edit protected modules; keep fix localized to mv_npu_top integration/control sequencing.
expected_side_effects: mat_ready should assert and accept required matrix beats without timeout.
Row-result delivery to postproc becomes deterministic under backpressure.
After deadlock removal, any remaining value/timing mismatches may surface and must be checked in full regression.
